newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo sets $55 mln Euro-convertible.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo sets $55 mln Euro-convertible.

text.p: South Korea's Daewoo Corp will issue a $55 million zero coupon Euro-convertible bond maturing on December 31, 2007, a co-lead manager said on Friday.
Daewoo Securities said the bond would be convertible into Daewoo Corp's common shares between May 25, 1997 and November 30, 2002 at a conversion price of 5,935 won per share.
Other co-lead manager is ING-Baring Securities.
The conversion price was set at a 15 percent premium on the stock's closing price of 5,160 won on Thursday.
A Daewoo Securities statement said the bond would carry a put option, exercisable on March 26, 2002 at yield of 7.61 percent.
Payment is due to be closed on March 26.

Daewoo Corp, a construction and trading unit of the Daewoo Group, plans to spend the proceeds from the issue to help finance overseas construction projects and facility investment, the statement said.
